items.title: 63520_Ernie Fields oral history interview
items.q: But he was the high man with Lunsford.

ctx.x: He may have. I don't remember.
But he was the high man with Lunsford.

Well, his home is Tuskegee and he meant a lot to me, a little competition between us and Hawkins, was at Alabama State at Montgomery and they began to talk about him, so we were trying to have a little group to outdo Erskine Hawkins down at Alabama State.
